name: observe-drag-ticks
description: The host delivers the steps of a native drag as the notice diagnostics-tick: two steps that each end a leg, then a step that the host could not pace with its error text; the page sends no call for them.
reason: diagnostics-tick is a notice that the host sends for a drag of a window, and the Go producer runs without a window and cannot deliver it (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).

payload.error: the window is on no display with a refresh rate
